rotation: Cyclic; each slot appears in each ordinal position twice

artifacts.adapter: The identical Todo workload and optimized view use each branch’s existing completion API. Main uses Runtime.makeApplication; the candidate uses Block.make/makeLayer and a Program pair. Each optimized slot renames only its HTML entry to index.html for the unchanged driver.

limitations: Reuses the previously built and independently reviewed actual-main artifacts; no independent fresh install or baseline rebuild.
Matched cached dependencies, not independent fresh installs from branch lockfiles
The copied harness has no Git metadata; its archive and tracked files are pinned independently
The actual-main build was copied byte-for-byte from the independently reviewed November 4 batch, with Git-blob Source checks and fresh functional preflights

verification.counterCoverage: The fifth run per slot is printed as a representative counter row; the driver does not emit all per-run counters or bucket timings
verification.isolationCoverage: The hash-verified unchanged driver rejects page errors and loss of cross-origin isolation on every run; quiet timing and port closure are execution-receipt attestations

limitations: One same-batch Todo comparison, not a general performance or statistical equivalence claim
Whole candidate versus main; no causal attribution to an individual feature
Individual totals are rounded to one decimal; reported total medians are checked within 0.1 ms
Sync and animation-frame bucket medians are independently reported and cannot be summed to reconstruct the total median
Only representative workload counters are observable; no claim that the analyser checks every run’s counters
Host metadata is captured before and after, not continuous whole-host profiling
